timeoutSemantics.semantics: In Node.js fetch(), response headers must arrive before the promise resolves; connectTimer functions as a response-header / response-start deadline concurrently with headerTimeoutMs rather than a pure TCP socket connection timer. The 30,000ms value is preserved to allow reasoning models sufficient time to generate internal reasoning tokens before emitting headers.

modelPolicy.frontier: none required (all candidate frontier models disabled)

liveCanaryResult.prompt: Generate clean markdown documentation comments for the verified rate limiter functions.
liveCanaryResult.complexityReason: prompt keyword 'functions' triggered medium complexity baseline
liveCanaryResult.observation: De-escalation prevented escalation above baseline, successfully stepping down from preceding high-reasoning cases (4-7) to medium effort on gemini-flash-medium without model flapping.

deterministicMultiTurnTest.prompt: add JSDoc comments to webhook handler functions
deterministicMultiTurnTest.observation: When the post-pass task is evaluated under low complexity, desired and effective reasoning effort de-escalate cleanly to low.

rootCauseAnalysis.port20201Issue: The canary script executes sequentially and shuts down upon completion, leaving sockets in TIME_WAIT. Upstream LLM calls for complex reasoning took 12-18 seconds, whereas connectTimeoutMs was defaulted to 10,000ms, causing premature connection_timeout aborts. Resolved by adding bounded /health polling, setting connectTimeoutMs to 30,000ms, handling signals gracefully, and ensuring clean teardown.
rootCauseAnalysis.concurrencyRouting: PostgreSQL concurrency prompt triggers complexity=high (via 'race condition'/'concurr'), risk=medium, routing to strong tier (ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high). Auto-reasoning evaluates desired=high, clamped=false, effective=high. Payload is serializable with duplicate reasoning fields stripped.
rootCauseAnalysis.isolationOfInfraFailures: Infrastructure failures (HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, network timeouts, upstream unavailable) are isolated from quality failures: complexity and minimum quality tier are prevented from escalating on infra failures, preserving baseline reasoning effort.
